HomePortfolio.title: Homes with Mediterranean soul
HomePortfolio.paragraph1: Every home begins with a conversation: how you want to wake up, welcome guests, and cook. In Marbella, Málaga, and the Costa del Sol I create residential interiors where Mediterranean light, natural materials, and quiet elegance meet, whether in a sea-view villa, a full renovation, a bespoke kitchen, or a terrace that extends the living room.
HomePortfolio.paragraph2: The gallery holds pieces of those stories: living rooms open to the horizon, restful bedrooms, lived-in outdoor spaces, and finishes you feel under your hand. Real interior design projects on the Costa del Sol, an invitation to picture yours before we take the first step together.

bio.p1: Stephania Pérez leads an interior design studio based in Marbella, focused on villas and second homes along the Costa del Sol. Her work balances Mediterranean light, natural materials, and timeless calm.
bio.p2: With training in interior architecture and years of experience in residential projects, Stephania guides each client from the first idea through final installation with a clear, personalized process.
bio.p3: We believe a home should reflect who you are: functional, beautiful, and deeply connected to its surroundings. Every space we design tells a story: yours.

intro.title: Our services
intro.lead: We offer a full range of interior design services for every type of project, including:

newConstruction.title: New construction
newConstruction.body: End-to-end design from planning: layout, lighting, materials, and furnishings for new villas and homes on the Costa del Sol, coordinated with local architects and builders.

renovations.title: Renovations
renovations.body: Transform existing spaces while honoring Mediterranean architecture: bathrooms, living areas, and outdoor zones, with site oversight and finish selection.

kitchen.title: Kitchen
kitchen.body: Bespoke kitchen design for the Costa del Sol: functional layouts, stone or porcelain countertops, integrated cabinetry, lighting, and premium appliances. From open-plan kitchens to gourmet spaces with a central island.

furnishings.title: Furniture, finishes, and accessories
furnishings.body: Curated furniture, textiles, lighting, and art to complete your home. We partner with trusted European makers and suppliers for a cohesive, lasting result.

process.title: The design process
process.lead: A structured journey so every phase stays transparent, collaborative, and aligned with your vision.

consultation.title: Initial consultation
consultation.body: In-person or virtual meeting to understand the space, your lifestyle, and project scope. We define goals, timeline, and a preliminary budget.

concept.title: Conceptual design
concept.body: Mood boards, material palettes, and layout sketches. We refine the aesthetic direction before moving into detailed documentation.

development.title: Design development
development.body: Plans, technical specifications, renders, and custom furniture selections. Every decision is documented for construction and vendors.

procurement.title: Procurement and project management
procurement.body: Ordering, logistics, installer coordination, and on-site quality control. You receive clear updates at every milestone.

install.title: Install and photography
install.body: Final installation, styling, and handover of a home ready to live in. We can optionally document the project for your personal archive.

PlacesPage.intro: We design across the Costa del Sol, from Marbella’s glamour to Málaga’s cultural energy and inland towns with Mediterranean soul.

marbella.name: Marbella
marbella.imageAlt: Marbella bay view with yachts and mountains in the distance
marbella.body: Villas with white porticos and golden light. In Marbella we create spaces that speak to the sea, golf, and an international lifestyle while keeping Mediterranean calm.

malaga.name: Málaga
malaga.imageAlt: Málaga seafront promenade and historic center at sunset
malaga.body: Urban penthouses, classic apartments, and characterful renovations. Málaga brings culture, food, and a unique light we reflect through warm materials and fluid layouts.

benalmadena.name: Benalmádena
benalmadena.imageAlt: Benalmádena coastline with cliffs and turquoise sea
benalmadena.body: Between marina and hills, Benalmádena calls for fresh interiors, lived-in terraces, and seamless indoor-outdoor living, perfect for second homes by the Mediterranean.

torremolinos.name: Torremolinos
torremolinos.imageAlt: Torremolinos seafront promenade with palm trees at dusk
torremolinos.body: Seafront apartments, sun-filled renovations, and homes with the pulse of a coastal town. In Torremolinos we aim for bright, practical interiors and terraces made for Mediterranean evenings.

fuengirola.name: Fuengirola
fuengirola.imageAlt: Beach and blue horizon in Fuengirola
fuengirola.body: Between Sohail Castle and the promenade, Fuengirola blends fishing-town roots with a cosmopolitan rhythm. We design primary and second homes with sun-ready materials, open living areas, and kitchens built for gathering after a day by the sea.

alhaurin.name: Alhaurín de la Torre
alhaurin.imageAlt: Andalusian landscape with olive trees near Alhaurín de la Torre
alhaurin.body: Beyond the coastline, the valley offers privacy and sierra views. Projects here celebrate local stone, shaded patios, and a slower pace just minutes from Málaga.
